reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Montana
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant raise "any legal defense" available to them?
    The statement is considered true only if the relevant law refers broadly to all defenses.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic helpers (standalone; no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% greater_of(+A,+B,-Greater)
greater_of(A, B, A) :- A >= B, !.
greater_of(_A, B, B) :- !.

% months_between(+MonthIndex1,+MonthIndex2,-DeltaMonths)
% Simple numeric month index model (e.g., 2021-01 -> 2021*12+1).
months_between(M1, M2, Delta) :-
    Delta is M2 - M1.

% within_last_months(+Months,+EarlierMonthIndex,+LaterMonthIndex)
within_last_months(Months, Earlier, Later) :-
    months_between(Earlier, Later, Delta),
    Delta >= 0,
    Delta =< Months.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (Montana, 2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* MT Code  70-24-303 (2021): landlord duties to maintain premises (health/safety, habitability, etc.) */
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(comply_building_housing_codes_materially_affecting_health_safety). % (1)(a)
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(make_repairs_keep_fit_habitable_except_tenant_responsibility).    % (1)(b)
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(keep_common_areas_clean_safe).                                    % (1)(c)
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(maintain_facilities_electrical_plumbing_heating_etc).             % (1)(d)
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(provide_receptacles_and_arrange_removal_waste_unless_agreement).  % (1)(e)
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(supply_running_water_hot_water_reasonable_heat_oct1_may1_exceptions). % (1)(f)
mt_70_24_303_landlord_duty(install_verify_smoke_and_co_detectors_tenant_maintains_during_term).  % (1)(g)

% (3)-(4) agreements allowing tenant to perform certain landlord duties, with conditions.
mt_70_24_303_tenant_may_assume_duty(duty_e_or_f_or_specified_repairs) :-
    % Transaction must be in good faith and not to evade landlord obligations.
    good_faith_transaction,
    not_for_purpose_of_evading_landlord_obligations.

mt_70_24_303_tenant_may_assume_duty(specified_repairs_maintenance_alteration_remodeling) :-
    separate_writing_signed_by_parties,
    supported_by_adequate_consideration,
    good_faith_transaction,
    not_for_purpose_of_evading_landlord_obligations,
    work_not_necessary_to_cure_noncompliance_with_building_code_health_safety,
    agreement_does_not_diminish_obligation_to_other_tenants.

% Placeholder condition facts (not asserted in this scenario; provided for completeness).
good_faith_transaction :- fail.
not_for_purpose_of_evading_landlord_obligations :- fail.
separate_writing_signed_by_parties :- fail.
supported_by_adequate_consideration :- fail.
work_not_necessary_to_cure_noncompliance_with_building_code_health_safety :- fail.
agreement_does_not_diminish_obligation_to_other_tenants :- fail.


/* MT Code  70-24-406 (2021): failure to maintain premises; tenant remedies */
% (1) Remedies are available for noncompliance with 70-24-303 affecting health and safety, with notice.
mt_70_24_406_health_safety_noncompliance_requires_notice(written_notice_specifying_breach_and_termination_date).
mt_70_24_406_standard_timeline(termination_notice_days_min(30), cure_days(14)).
mt_70_24_406_emergency_timeline(emergency_cure_working_days(3)).

% (1)(a)(iii) tenant may not terminate for condition caused by tenant/family/others with consent.
mt_70_24_406_termination_barred_if_caused_by_tenant_or_household_or_guests.

% (1)(b) repair-and-deduct limit: <= 1 month's rent, after notice and reasonable time.
mt_70_24_406_repair_and_deduct_limit(max_cost_months_rent(1)).

% (2) tenant may recover actual damages and injunctive relief for noncompliance with rental agreement or 70-24-303.
mt_70_24_406_remedy(actual_damages).
mt_70_24_406_remedy(injunctive_relief).

% (4) return security if rental agreement terminated.
mt_70_24_406_security_return_required_if_terminated.


/* MT Code  70-24-407 (2021): damages for minor violations by landlord */
mt_70_24_407_minor_violation_threshold(cost_less_than_one_month_rent).
mt_70_24_407_remedy_is_damages_under_70_24_406_2.


/* MT Code  70-24-408 (2021): failure to provide essential services; tenant remedies */
mt_70_24_408_essential_services([heat, running_water, hot_water, electric, gas, other_essential_services]).
mt_70_24_408_prerequisites([written_notice_specifying_breach, reasonable_opportunity_to_correct]).
mt_70_24_408_no_rights_if_caused_by_tenant_or_household_or_guests.

mt_70_24_408_tenant_option(procure_services_and_deduct_actual_reasonable_cost).  % (1)(a)
mt_70_24_408_tenant_option(recover_damages_diminution_in_fair_rental_value).     % (1)(b)
mt_70_24_408_tenant_option(procure_substitute_housing_excused_from_rent).        % (1)(c)

mt_70_24_408_election_of_remedies_bar(cannot_also_proceed_under_70_24_406_or_70_24_407_for_same_breach).


/* MT Code  70-24-411 (2021): unlawful ouster/exclusion/diminution of service; tenant remedies */
mt_70_24_411_applies_if(landlord_unlawfully_removes_or_excludes_tenant).
mt_70_24_411_applies_if(landlord_purposefully_diminishes_services_by_interrupting_essential_services).

mt_70_24_411_tenant_may(recover_possession).
mt_70_24_411_tenant_may(terminate_rental_agreement).

% Damages: not more than 3 months' periodic rent OR treble damages, whichever is greater.
mt_70_24_411_damage_cap_months_rent(3).
mt_70_24_411_damage_measure(periodic_rent_months(Months), amount(Amount)) :-
    mt_70_24_411_damage_cap_months_rent(Cap),
    Months =< Cap,
    Amount is Months. % abstract unit placeholder
mt_70_24_411_treble_damages(Base, Treble) :-
    Treble is Base * 3.
mt_70_24_411_whichever_greater(OptionA, OptionB, Greater) :-
    greater_of(OptionA, OptionB, Greater).

mt_70_24_411_if_terminated_landlord_must_return(security_and_prepaid_rent).


/* MT Code  70-24-431 (2021): retaliatory conduct prohibited; tenant defense in retaliatory possession action */
% (1) Prohibited retaliation actions (increase rent, decrease services, bring/threaten possession action)
mt_70_24_431_retaliation_action(increasing_rent).
mt_70_24_431_retaliation_action(decreasing_services).
mt_70_24_431_retaliation_action(bringing_or_threatening_action_for_possession).

% (1)(a)-(c) tenant protected activities triggering retaliation protection
mt_70_24_431_trigger(complained_to_government_agency_building_or_housing_code_health_safety).
mt_70_24_431_trigger(written_complaint_to_landlord_violation_under_70_24_303).
mt_70_24_431_trigger(organized_or_joined_tenants_union_or_similar).

% (2) If landlord violates (1): tenant entitled to remedies under 70-24-411 AND has a defense in any retaliatory action for possession.
mt_70_24_431_tenant_entitled_to_remedies_under_70_24_411_if_retaliation.
mt_70_24_431_tenant_has_defense_in_retaliatory_action_for_possession(retaliation_defense).

% (3) Rebuttable presumption: complaint within 6 months before alleged retaliation creates presumption,
% unless complaint was after notice of proposed rent increase or diminution of services.
mt_70_24_431_rebuttable_presumption_applies(ComplaintMonthIndex, RetaliationMonthIndex) :-
    within_last_months(6, ComplaintMonthIndex, RetaliationMonthIndex),
    \+ mt_70_24_431_presumption_does_not_arise_due_to_timing.

mt_70_24_431_presumption_does_not_arise_due_to_timing :-
    complaint_made_after_notice_of_proposed_rent_increase_or_diminution_of_services.

% Placeholder condition fact (not asserted in this scenario; provided for completeness).
complaint_made_after_notice_of_proposed_rent_increase_or_diminution_of_services :- fail.

% (4) Exceptions: retaliation provisions do not prevent landlord from bringing possession action if:
mt_70_24_431_exception(code_violation_primarily_caused_by_tenant_or_household_or_guests).
mt_70_24_431_exception(tenant_in_default_in_rent).
mt_70_24_431_exception(compliance_requires_alteration_remodeling_or_demolition_depriving_use).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal interpretation for this QA: "any legal defense" vs specific defenses
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% A statute grants a defense with a particular scope.
% scope(any_legal_defense) would mean the law broadly authorizes "any legal defense" in the eviction action.
% scope(specific(DefenseType)) means it authorizes a particular defense only.
statute_defense_scope(montana, 2021, mt_code_70_24_431, scope(specific(retaliation_defense_for_possession_actions_only))) :-
    mt_70_24_431_tenant_has_defense_in_retaliatory_action_for_possession(retaliation_defense).

% If any relevant statute provides a broadly phrased "any legal defense", then this holds.
tenant_may_raise_any_legal_defense_in_eviction(State, Year) :-
    statute_defense_scope(State, Year, _Citation, scope(any_legal_defense)),
    !.

% Otherwise, no broad "any legal defense" authorization is found in the encoded statutes.
tenant_may_raise_any_legal_defense_in_eviction(_State, _Year) :-
    !,
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts) + scenario_statement/0
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Scenario parameters
scenario_state(montana).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Scenario: eviction action (possession) and tenant attempts to raise "any legal defense".
scenario_action(eviction_action_for_possession).
scenario_tenant_claims_right_to_raise(any_legal_defense).

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the scenario facts match the described statement.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(montana),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(eviction_action_for_possession),
    scenario_tenant_claims_right_to_raise(any_legal_defense).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer derivation (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    tenant_may_raise_any_legal_defense_in_eviction(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant raise "any legal defense" available to them? This is true when the relevant law refers broadly to all defenses that might be raised.
